title: 八成网红撑场：触屏MacBook来了，iPad销量真不受影响？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: You know, the real reason they never wanted to do this was because they didn't want to compromise sales of both the Mac and the iPad, but at some point you have to make the iPad as good as it can be, and at some point you have to make the Mac as good as it can be, and part of that is implementing a touch OLED display.
segments.zh: 他们一直不愿这么做，真正原因是怕影响Mac和iPad的销量，但迟早得让iPad尽可能出色，也得让Mac尽可能出色，其中一部分就是采用触控OLED屏。

segments.en: You can't worry that that is going to cannibalize sales the other products.
segments.zh: 你不能担心这会蚕食其他产品的销量。

segments.en: Seeing the introduction of this macro pro like I knew this was going to be the case, but actually seeing it in practice today, this is not going to compromise iPad sales.
segments.zh: 看到这款Mac Pro的推出，我就知道会是这样，但今天实际看到，这不会影响iPad的销量。

segments.en: Of course the room was very excited. They had about a few media members and then 80% of the room was influencers coming to this event on Apple's dime.
segments.zh: 当然，现场非常兴奋。大约有几家媒体成员，然后80%的到场者都是苹果买单来参加活动的网红。

segments.en: So maybe that's why people would probably have something to do.
segments.zh: 所以也许这就是为什么人们可能会有事可做。

segments.en: But me, there's just like a fun product. Yeah, no, I love it. I ordered one. I am psyched for this. I've been waiting for this for years. You can put me at the top of the list of people who wanted a touchscreen MacBook Pro.
segments.zh: 但对我来说，这就像个有趣的产品。是的，不，我喜欢它。我订了一台。我对此很兴奋。我已经等了好几年了。你可以把我列为最想要触屏MacBook Pro的人之一。

segments.en: It's about damn time as LeBron James would say.
segments.zh: 正如勒布朗·詹姆斯所说，是时候了。
